title: A/P Summary has no Collapse all button
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: Your shop has open vendor documents and you look for a Collapse all button on A/P Summary.
  • You are an Admin user (the "Admin" role) working at {Location-A}, your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The report has open documents on today's date.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the table's top-left header cell.
  2. Hover over that cell.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no chevron button: the report has no groups.
  • Step 2: no "Collapse all" or "Expand all" tooltip shows.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 9 (23 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 26 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11534 (Story 4, Collapse all, Expand all and pinned group rows)

  • S4-N2: “A/R Summary and A/P Summary have no groups, so they have no Collapse all button.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
